caption: The drawing shows a rectangular section of a wall, divided into two main parts. The upper section features a green-hued, rectangular framed area with abstract, loosely painted green shapes and brushstrokes. The lower section is a decorative frieze, running horizontally, containing a repeating scroll pattern of stylized leaves and flowers in blue, green, gold, and brown, with a central ornamental vase or urn motif. Lines and faint diagrams mark the boundaries of the areas, with some yellow and brown diagonal guideline markings visible around the framed portion. On the right side of the drawing, there are partial floral sketches done in pencil that are not fully colored. The bottom margin of the drawing includes a simple red horizontal band, below which some areas are shaded lightly with green. The background of the drawing is off-white, and the name "EDWARD TWINETT" appears printed in small letters in the bottom right margin.
title: Detail, Painted Decoration on Sanctuary Wall
